title: Black Sesame Seed Brittle
ldIngredientsRaw: 5 ½ oz light corn syrup (1 cup)
ldInstructionsRaw: Line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat or parchment paper. You can also butter the pan if you don't have a baking mat or parchment.

Combine 4 oz water, 16 oz granulated sugar, ¼ teaspoon cream of tartar and 5 ½ oz light corn syrup in a heavy saucepan. Stir the mixture until it begins to boil. Once the mixture starts boiling do not stir. Cook the sugar until it becomes a golden caramel color. If using a candy  or probe thermometer set the temperature to 350 °F.

Remove the pan from the heat and immediately stir in 1 oz unsalted butter, ¾ cup black sesame seeds, 1 teaspoon baking soda and ⅛ teaspoon table salt. Pour the mixture onto the prepared pan and spread it to an even layer. Set the brittle aside to cool completely and harden, about 30 minutes.
Peel the sheet of brittle off the pan and set it back down. Use a heavy meat tenderizer or other heavy tool to crack the sheet into shards.
Store in a covered container at room temperature.
